answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 118 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the raven challenge, the yarrow audit can replay the zenith history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 58 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward.
